h: וַיַּקְהֵ֣ל מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֶֽת־כָּל־עֲדַ֛ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֑ם
t: וְאַכְנֵשׁ משֶׁה יָת כָּל כְּנִשְׁתָּא דִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַאֲמַר לְהוֹן
e: Moshe assembled the entire congregation of the B’nei Yisrael, and said to them,
“These are the words
that Adonoy has commanded you to do.

h: וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י יִהְיֶ֨ה לָכֶ֥ם קֹ֛דֶשׁ שַׁבַּ֥ת שַׁבָּת֖וֹן לַיהוָ֑ה
t: וּבְיוֹמָא שְׁבִיעָאָה יְהֵי לְכוֹן קוּדְשָׁא שַׁבָּא שַׁבְּתָא קֳדָם יְיָ
e: Work may be done six days,
but the seventh day must be holy to you, it is a Shabbos of Shabbos to [before] Adonoy.
Whoever does work on it shall be put to death.
eo: Work may be done six days,
but the seventh day must be holy to you, it is a Shabbos of Shabbos before Adonoy.
Whoever does work on it shall be put to death.

e: You must not kindle a fire
in all your dwelling places
on the day of Shabbos.”
Moshe said
to the entire congregation of the B’nei Yisrael, saying,
“This is the word
that Adonoy has commanded:
Take [collect] from among yourselves a terumah-offering to [before] Adonoy.
Every man who is generous of heart
shall bring a terumah-offering to [before] Adonoy:
gold, silver and copper,
eo: Take [collect] from among yourselves a terumah-offering before Adonoy.
Every man who is generous of heart
shall bring a terumah-offering before Adonoy:
gold, silver and copper,

h: וּתְכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ וְעִזִּֽים׃
e: And greenish-blue wool, dark red wool, crimson [colored] wool, fine linen, and goat’s hair,
eo: And greenish-blue wool, dark red wool, crimson colored wool, fine linen, and goat’s hair,

h: וְעֹרֹ֨ת אֵילִ֧ם מְאָדָּמִ֛ים וְעֹרֹ֥ת תְּחָשִׁ֖ים וַעֲצֵ֥י שִׂטִּֽים׃
t: וּמַשְׁכֵי דְדִכְרֵי מְסַמְּקֵי וּמַשְׁכֵי דְסַסְגוֹנָא וְאָעֵי שִׁטִּין:
e: and red-[dyed] rams’ skins, tachash [multicolored] skins, and acacia wood,
V.oe: and red-[dyed] rams’ skins, tachash [multicolored] skins, and accacia wood,
eo: and red-[dyed] rams’ skins, multicolored skins, and acacia wood,

e: and oil for the light,
spices for anointing oil,
and for the incense of aromatic spices,
V.oe: and oil for the light, spices for annointing oil, and for the incense of aromatic spices,

e: and onyx stones, and stones for setting into
the ephod and the breastplate.
All those who are wise in heart among you
shall come and make
all that Adonoy has commanded.

t: יָת מַשְׁכְּנָא יָת פְּרָסֵיהּ וְיָת חוֹפָאֵיהּ
יָת עַבְרוֹהִי יָת עַמּוּדוֹהִי וְיָת סַמְכוֹהִי:
e: The mishkon, its tent and its cover,
its clasps, and its planks,
its bars, its pillars and its sockets.

t: יָת אֲרוֹנָא וְיָת אֲרִיחוֹהִי יָת כַּפֻּרְתָּא
e: The ark and its poles, its cover
and the partition screen.

t: יָת פָּתוֹרָא וְיָת אֲרִיחוֹהִי וְיָת כָּל מָנוֹהִי
e: The table and its poles, and all its vessels,
and the show breads.

t: וְיָת מְנַרְתָּא דְאַנְהוֹרֵי וְיָת מָנָהָא וְיָת בּוֹצִינָהָא
e: The menorah for light, and its vessels, and its lamps
and the oil for the light.
The incense [spices] altar, and its poles,
and the anointing oil,
and the incense of aromatic spices,
and the screen for the entrance, at the entrance of the mishkon.
V.oe: The incense [spices] altar, and its poles, and the annointing oil, and the incense of aromatic spices, and the screen for the entrance, at the entrance of the mishkon.
eo: The incense spices altar, and its poles,
and the anointing oil,
and the incense of aromatic spices,
and the screen for the entrance, at the entrance of the mishkon.

h: אֵ֣ת מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֗ה וְאֶת־מִכְבַּ֤ר הַנְּחֹ֙שֶׁת֙ אֲשֶׁר־ל֔וֹ
t: יָת מַדְבְּחָא דַעֲלָתָא וְיָת סְרָדָא דִנְחָשָׁא דִּילֵיהּ
e: The altar for burnt-offerings, with its copper grate,
its poles and all its vessels,
the laver and its base.
The curtains for the enclosure,
its pillars and its sockets,
and the screen for the entrance of the enclosure.

t: יָת סִכֵּי מַשְׁכְּנָא וְיָת סִכֵּי דְדַרְתָּא וְיָת אַטּוּנֵיהוֹן:
e: The stakes of the mishkon, and the stakes of the enclosure and their ropes.
The covering cloths [of service] for the holy articles [to serve in the Sanctuary],
and the sacred garments for Aharon the kohein,
and the garments for his sons to wear when they serve.
eo: The covering cloths of service to serve in the Sanctuary,
and the sacred garments for Aharon the kohein,
and the garments for his sons to wear when they serve.

t: וּנְפָקוּ כָּל כְּנִשְׁתָּא דִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִן קֳדָם משֶׁה:
e: The entire congregation of the B’nei Yisrael departed from the presence of Moshe.

h: וְכֹ֡ל אֲשֶׁר֩ נָדְבָ֨ה רוּח֜וֹ אֹת֗וֹ הֵ֠בִיאוּ אֶת־תְּרוּמַ֨ת יְהוָ֜ה לִמְלֶ֨אכֶת אֹ֤הֶל מוֹעֵד֙ וּלְכָל־עֲבֹ֣דָת֔וֹ
t: וְכֹל דִּי אַשְׁלֵמַת רוּחֵיהּ יָתֵיהּ אַיְתִיאוּ יָת אַפְרָשׁוּתָא קֳדָם יְיָ לַעֲבִידַת מַשְׁכַּן זִמְנָא וּלְכָל פֻּלְחָנֵיהּ
e: Every man whose heart lifted him up came —
and every one whose generous spirit inspired [filled] him brought a terumah-offering to [before] Adonoy, for the work of the Tent of Meeting, and for all [that was needed for] its service,
and for the sacred garments.
eo: Every man whose heart lifted him up came —
and every one whose generous spirit filled him brought a terumah-offering before Adonoy, for the work of the Tent of Meeting, and for all [that was needed for] its service,
and for the sacred garments.

h: כֹּ֣ל נְדִ֣יב לֵ֗ב הֵ֠בִיאוּ חָ֣ח וָנֶ֜זֶם וְטַבַּ֤עַת וְכוּמָז֙ כָּל־כְּלִ֣י זָהָ֔ב
וְכָל־אִ֕ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֵנִ֛יף תְּנוּפַ֥ת זָהָ֖ב לַיהוָֽה׃
t: כֹּל דְּאִתְרְעֵי לִבֵּיהּ אַיְתִיאוּ שֵׁירִין וְשִׁבְכִין וְעִזְקַן וּמָחוּךְ כָּל מָן דִּדְהַב
וְכָל גְּבַר דִּי אֲרֵים אֲרָמוּת דַּהֲבָא קֳדָם יְיָ:
e: And they came — both men and [brought — men in addition to] woman —
all who were generous of heart brought bracelets, nose rings, finger rings, and buckles — all kinds of golden vessels —
and every man that offered a wave-offering of gold unto [before] Adonoy.
eo: And they brought — men in addition to woman —
all who were generous of heart brought bracelets, nose rings, finger rings, and buckles — all kinds of golden vessels —
and every man that offered a wave-offering of gold before Adonoy.

notes: אֲרֵים is literally "raised", as an uplifted offering.

h: וְכָל־אִ֞ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־נִמְצָ֣א אִתּ֗וֹ תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֣שׁ וְעִזִּ֑ים
וְעֹרֹ֨ת אֵילִ֧ם מְאָדָּמִ֛ים וְעֹרֹ֥ת תְּחָשִׁ֖ים הֵבִֽיאוּ׃
t: וְכָל גְּבַר דְּאִשְׁתְּכַח עִמֵּיהּ תִּכְלָא וְאַרְגְּוָנָא וּצְבַע זְהוֹרִי וּבוּץ וּמְעַזֵּי
וּמַשְׁכֵי דְדִכְרֵי מְסַמְּקֵי וּמַשְׁכֵי סַסְגּוֹנָא אַיְתִיאוּ:
e: Every man who had with him greenish-blue wool, dark red wool, crimson [colored] wool, fine linen, goats’ hair,
red dyed rams’ skins, and tachash [multicolored] skins brought them.
eo: Every man who had with him greenish-blue wool, dark red wool, crimson colored wool, fine linen, goats’ hair,
red dyed rams’ skins, and multicolored skins brought them.

h: וְכֹ֡ל אֲשֶׁר֩ נִמְצָ֨א אִתּ֜וֹ עֲצֵ֥י שִׁטִּ֛ים לְכָל־מְלֶ֥אכֶת הָעֲבֹדָ֖ה הֵבִֽיאוּ׃
t: וְכֹל דִּי אִשְׁתְּכַח עִמֵּיהּ אָעֵי שִׁטִּין לְכָל עִבִידַת פֻּלְחָנָא אַיְתִיאוּ:
e: Everyone who did lift up a terumah-offering of silver or copper,
brought the terumah-offering to [before] Adonoy;
and everyone who had with him acacia wood for use in the work of the service, brought it.
eo: Everyone who did lift up a terumah-offering of silver or copper,
brought the terumah-offering before Adonoy;
and everyone who had with him acacia wood for use in the work of the service, brought it.

t: וְכָל אִתְּתָא חַכִּימַת לִבָּא בִּידָהָא מְעַזְּלָא
וּמַיְתַן כַּד עָזֵל יָת תִּכְלָא וְיָת אַרְגְּוָנָא
e: And every wise-hearted woman spun with her hands;
and they brought the spun yarn of greenish-blue wool, dark red wool,
crimson [colored] wool and fine linen.
eo: And every wise-hearted woman spun with her hands;
and they brought the spun yarn of greenish-blue wool, dark red wool,
crimson colored wool and fine linen.

h: וְכָל־הַ֨נָּשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָשָׂ֥א לִבָּ֛ן אֹתָ֖נָה בְּחָכְמָ֑ה
t: וְכָל נְשַׁיָּא דְּאִתְרְעֵי לִבְּהֶן עִמְּהֶן בְּחָכְמָא
e: And all the women whose hearts inspired them with wisdom,
spun the goat’s hair.
And the leaders [of the tribes] brought
onyx stones,
and stones for setting into
the ephod and breastplate.
And the spices, and the oil
for the light, and the anointing oil,
and the incense of aromatic spices.

h: כָּל־אִ֣ישׁ וְאִשָּׁ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָדַ֣ב לִבָּם֮ אֹתָם֒
t: כָּל גְּבַר וְאִתְּתָא דְּאִתְרְעֵי לִבְּהוֹן עִמְּהוֹן
דִּי פַקֵּד יְיָ לְמֶעְבַּד בִּידָא דְמשֶׁה
e: Every man and woman whose generous heart inspired them
to bring something for all the work
that Adonoy had commanded to be done through Moshe [did so].
The B’nei Yisrael brought a free-will gift to [before] Adonoy.
eo: Every man and woman whose generous heart inspired them
to bring something for all the work
that Adonoy had commanded to be done through Moshe [did so].
The B’nei Yisrael brought a free-will gift before Adonoy.

t: בְּצַלְאֵל בַּר אוּרִי בַר חוּר לְשִׁבְטָא דִיהוּדָה:
e: Moshe said to the B’nei Yisrael,
“See, Adonoy has designated [exalted] by name,
Betzalel, son of Uri, son of Chur, of the tribe of Yehudah.
eo: Moshe said to the B’nei Yisrael,
“See, Adonoy has exalted by name,
Betzalel, son of Uri, son of Chur, of the tribe of Yehudah.

t: וְאַשְׁלֵם עִמֵּיהּ רוּחַ נְבוּאָה מִן קֳדָם יְיָ
e: And He endowed him with Divine [the] spirit [of prophecy from before Adonoy],
with wisdom, with understanding, with knowledge and with [the skill to perform] all types of crafting.
eo: And He endowed him with the spirit of prophecy from before Adonoy,
with wisdom, with understanding, with knowledge and with [the skill to perform] all types of crafting.

e: And to devise [plans] [teach craftsmanship] with ingenuity,
to execute [those plans] in gold, in silver and in copper.
eo: And to teach craftsmanship with ingenuity,
to execute [those plans] in gold, in silver and in copper.

e: And in masonry [to cut precious stones] for settings, and in carpentry,
to execute all kinds of clever tasks [of craftsmanship].
V.oe: And in masonary [to cut precious stones] for settings, and in carpentry, to execute all kinds of clever tasks [of craftsmanship].
eo: And to cut precious stones for settings, and in carpentry,
to execute all kinds of craftsmanship.

t: הוּא וְאָהֳלִיאָב בַּר אֲחִיסָמָךְ לְשִׁבְטָא דְדָן:
e: And the ability to instruct he instilled in his heart,
he (Betzalel) and Oholiov, the son of Achisomoch of the tribe of Dan.

h: מִלֵּ֨א אֹתָ֜ם חָכְמַת־לֵ֗ב לַעֲשׂוֹת֮ כָּל־מְלֶ֣אכֶת חָרָ֣שׁ וְחֹשֵׁב֒
וְרֹקֵ֞ם בַּתְּכֵ֣לֶת וּבָֽאַרְגָּמָ֗ן בְּתוֹלַ֧עַת הַשָּׁנִ֛י וּבַשֵּׁ֖שׁ וְאֹרֵ֑ג
t: אַשְׁלֵם עִמְּהוֹן חַכִּימוּת לִבָּא לְמֶעְבַּד כָּל עִבִידַת נַגָּר וְאָמָּן
וְצַיָּר בְּתִכְלָא וּבְאַרְגְּוָנָא בִּצְבַע זְהוֹרִי וּבְבוּצָא וּמַחֵי
e: He filled them with wisdom of the heart, to execute all the tasks of the engraver [carpenter], the craftsman,
and the embroiderer of greenish-blue wool, dark red wool, crimson [colored] wool, fine linen, and the [the tasks of] weaver,
[also] that of laborers
and planners [those who teach craftsmanship].
eo: He filled them with wisdom of the heart, to execute all the tasks of the carpenter, the craftsman,
and the embroiderer of greenish-blue wool, dark red wool, crimson colored wool, fine linen, and the [the tasks of] weaver,
[also] that of laborers
and those who teach craftsmanship.

h: וְעָשָׂה֩ בְצַלְאֵ֨ל וְאָהֳלִיאָ֜ב וְכֹ֣ל אִ֣ישׁ חֲכַם־לֵ֗ב אֲשֶׁר֩ נָתַ֨ן יְהוָ֜ה חָכְמָ֤ה וּתְבוּנָה֙ בָּהֵ֔מָּה
t: וַעֲבַד בְּצַלְאֵל וְאָהֳלִיאָב וְכָל גְּבַר חַכִּים לִבָּא דִּיהַב יְיָ חָכְמָא וְסוּכְלְתָנוּתָא בְּהוֹן
e: And they shall execute — Betzalel and Oholiov — and every wise-hearted man whom Adonoy had endowed with wisdom and insight
to know (how) to execute
in all of the holy work —
all that Adonoy had commanded.
Moshe called to Betzalel and to Oholiov,
and to every wise-hearted man
whom Adonoy had endowed with wisdom in his heart,
everyone whose heart moved him
to approach the task — to execute it.

h: וַיִּקְח֞וּ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֵ֤ת כָּל־הַתְּרוּמָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵבִ֜יאוּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לִמְלֶ֛אכֶת עֲבֹדַ֥ת הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ לַעֲשֹׂ֣ת אֹתָ֑הּ
וְ֠הֵם הֵבִ֨יאוּ אֵלָ֥יו ע֛וֹד נְדָבָ֖ה בַּבֹּ֥קֶר בַּבֹּֽקֶר׃
t: וּנְסִיבוּ מִן קֳדָם משֶׁה יָת כָּל אַפְרָשׁוּתָא דִּי אַיְתִיאוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְעִבִידַת פָּלְחַן קוּדְשָׁא לְמֶעְבַּד יָתַהּ
וְאִנּוּן מַיְתַן לֵיהּ עוֹד נְדַבְתָּא בִּצְפַר בִּצְפָר:
e: And they took from before Moshe, all the terumah-offering which the B’nei Yisrael brought for the tasks of the holy work, to execute it.
And they continued to bring gifts each and every morning.
All the wise men came —
who were executing all the holy tasks —
each and every man from the task in which he was engaged.
They said the following to Moshe:
the people are bringing too much
— more than is needed
for the tasks which Adonoy has commanded to execute.

h: וַיְצַ֣ו מֹשֶׁ֗ה וַיַּעֲבִ֨ירוּ ק֥וֹל בַּֽמַּחֲנֶה֮ לֵאמֹר֒
אִ֣ישׁ וְאִשָּׁ֗ה אַל־יַעֲשׂוּ־ע֛וֹד מְלָאכָ֖ה לִתְרוּמַ֣ת הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ
t: וּפַקֵּד משֶׁה וְאַעֲבַרוּ כָרוֹזָא בְמַשְׁרִיתָא לְמֵימַר
גְּבַר וְאִתְּתָא לָא יַעַבְדוּן עוֹד עִבִדְתָּא לְאַפְרָשׁוּת קוּדְשָׁא
e: Moshe commanded — and they proclaimed throughout the encampment saying,
“Let no man or woman bring any more material for the sacred offering.”
And the people stopped bringing.

h: וְהַמְּלָאכָ֗ה הָיְתָ֥ה דַיָּ֛ם לְכָל־הַמְּלָאכָ֖ה לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת אֹתָ֑הּ
t: וְעִבִדְתָּא הֲוַת מִסַּת לְכָל עִבִדְתָּא לְמֶעְבַּד יָתַהּ
e: The material was enough for all the work that had to be done,
and some was left over.

h: וַיַּעֲשׂ֨וּ כָל־חֲכַם־לֵ֜ב בְּעֹשֵׂ֧י הַמְּלָאכָ֛ה אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן עֶ֣שֶׂר יְרִיעֹ֑ת
שֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֗ר וּתְכֵ֤לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן֙ וְתוֹלַ֣עַת שָׁנִ֔י
t: וַעֲבָדוּ כָל חַכִּימֵי לִבָּא בְּעָבְדֵי עִבִדְתָּא יָת מַשְׁכְּנָא עֲשַׂר יְרִיעָן
צוּרַת כְּרוּבִין עוֹבַד אָמָּן עֲבַד יָתְהוֹן:
e: All craftsmen with the spirit of wisdom made the mishkon out of ten drapes,
(consisting of) twined fine linen, greenish blue wool, dark red wool and crimson [colored] wool,
figures of Cherubim, the work of a craftsman.
eo: All craftsmen with the spirit of wisdom made the mishkon out of ten drapes,
(consisting of) twined fine linen, greenish blue wool, dark red wool and crimson colored wool,
figures of Cherubim, the work of a craftsman.

h: אֹ֜רֶךְ הַיְרִיעָ֣ה הָֽאַחַ֗ת שְׁמֹנֶ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה
t: אֻרְכָּא דִּירִיעֲתָא חֲדָא עַסְרִין וּתְמַנְיָא אַמִּין
e: The length of each drape was twenty eight amohs,
and each drape was four amohs wide.
All drapes had the same measure.

t: וְלָפֵף יָת חָמֵשׁ יְרִיעָן חֲדָא עִם חֲדָא
e: He joined (sewed) five of these drapes together,
and the other five drapes
he joined (sewed) together.

h: וַיַּ֜עַשׂ לֻֽלְאֹ֣ת תְּכֵ֗לֶת עַ֣ל שְׂפַ֤ת הַיְרִיעָה֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ת
t: וַעֲבַד עֲנוּבִין דְּתִכְלָא עַל סִפְתָא דִירִיעֲתָא חֲדָא
e: He made loops of greenish blue wool on the edge of the drape
which was at the (innermost) end of the (first) group.
He did the same on the edge of the drape
which was the innermost end of the second group.
He made fifty loops on (the edge of) one drape
and he made fifty loops on the edge
of the drape which was on the second group.
The loops were opposite one another.

t: וְלָפֵף יָת יְרִיעֲתָא חֲדָא עִם חֲדָא בְּפוּרְפַיָּא
e: He made fifty golden clasps
and he joined the drapes (of each group) together with the clasps.
The mishkon was thus one unit.
He made drapes of goats’ hair
for a covering over the mishkon.
He made eleven such drapes.
The length of each drape was thirty amohs,
and the width of each drape was four amohs.
The eleven drapes were of the same measure.
And he joined together five drapes by themselves,
and six drapes by themselves.

h: וַיַּ֜עַשׂ לֻֽלָאֹ֣ת חֲמִשִּׁ֗ים עַ֚ל שְׂפַ֣ת הַיְרִיעָ֔ה
t: וַעֲבַד עֲנוּבִין חַמְשִׁין עַל סִפְתָא דִירִיעֲתָא
וְחַמְשִׁין עֲנוּבִין עֲבַד עַל סִפְתָא דִירִיעֲתָא
e: He made fifty loops on the edge of one drape
which was the innermost end of the (first) group
and he made fifty loops on the edge of the drape
which was on the second group.
He made fifty copper clasps
to join the tent together making it one.
He made a covering for the tent
out of red dyed rams’ skins,
and a covering of tachash [multicolored] skins above that.
eo: He made a covering for the tent
out of red dyed rams’ skins,
and a covering of multicolored skins above that.

e: He made planks for the mishkon
out of acacia wood; (these planks) stood upright (vertically).
Each plank was ten amohs long,
and one and one half amohs
was the width of each plank.
Each plank had two (square) pegs,
exactly parallel to each other.
In this manner he made
all the planks of the mishkon.
He made these planks for the mishkon,
twenty planks
for the southern side.

h: שְׁנֵ֨י אֲדָנִ֜ים תַּֽחַת־הַקֶּ֤רֶשׁ הָאֶחָד֙ לִשְׁתֵּ֣י יְדֹתָ֔יו
וּשְׁנֵ֧י אֲדָנִ֛ים תַּֽחַת־הַקֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָאֶחָ֖ד לִשְׁתֵּ֥י יְדֹתָֽיו׃
t: תְּרֵין סַמְכִין תְּחוֹת דַפָּא חַד לִתְרֵין צִירוֹהִי
וּתְרֵין סַמְכִין תְּחוֹת דַּפָּא חַד לִתְרֵין צִירוֹהִי:
e: He made forty silver sockets,
(and placed them) under the twenty planks.
There were two sockets under one plank (one) for each of the two pegs,
and two sockets under the other plank, (one) for each of the two pegs.
For the second wall of the mishkon, to the northern side,
he made twenty planks.
(He made) their forty silver sockets,
two sockets under each plank,
two sockets under each plank.
For the western end of the mishkon
he made six planks.
He made two planks
for the corners of the mishkon
at the rear side [their ends].
eo: He made two planks
for the corners of the mishkon
at their ends.

e: They were coupled together on the bottom,
and they were coupled together evenly on the top
with one (square) ring.
In this manner he made the two (planks)
which were at the two corners.

h: שְׁנֵ֤י אֲדָנִים֙ שְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֔ים תַּ֖חַת הַקֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָאֶחָֽד׃
t: תְּרֵין סַמְכִין תְּרֵין סַמְכִין תְּחוֹת דַּפָּא חָד:
e: There were eight planks,
and their silver sockets,
totaling sixteen sockets,
two sockets, two sockets under each plank.
He made bars out of acacia wood,
five for the planks of one wall,
and five bars
for the planks of the second wall of the mishkon,
and five bars for the planks of the
western (back) wall of the mishkon.
He made the middle (center) bar
to go through the planks,
[reinforcing the planks] from one end to the other.

h: וְֽאֶת־הַקְּרָשִׁ֞ים צִפָּ֣ה זָהָ֗ב וְאֶת־טַבְּעֹתָם֙ עָשָׂ֣ה זָהָ֔ב
t: וְיָת דַּפַּיָּא חֲפָא דַהֲבָא וְיָת עִזְקָתְהוֹן עֲבַד דַּהֲבָא
e: He overlaid the planks with gold, and made their rings out of gold
to hold the bars.
He (also) overlaid the bars with gold.

h: תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֑ר
t: עוֹבַד אָמָּן עֲבַד יָתַהּ צוּרַת כְּרוּבִין:
e: He made the paroches (partition)
out of greenish blue wool, dark red wool, crimson [colored] wool, and fine, twined linen,
the work of a craftsman, with figures of Cherubim (woven into it).
eo: He made the paroches (partition)
out of greenish blue wool, dark red wool, crimson colored wool, and fine, twined linen,
the work of a craftsman, with figures of Cherubim (woven into it).

e: He made for it (the paroches) four acacia-wood pillars
and he overlaid them with gold.
Their hooks were also of gold.
He cast
for them four silver sockets.

h: תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֑ר
e: He made a screen for the entrance of the tent,
of greenish blue wool, dark red wool, crimson [colored] wool, and fine twined linen.
It was the work of an embroiderer.
eo: He made a screen for the entrance of the tent,
of greenish blue wool, dark red wool, crimson colored wool, and fine twined linen.
It was the work of an embroiderer.

e: (He made) five pillars (to hold the screen), along with their hooks
and he overlaid their caps and bands with gold.
Their five sockets (he made of) copper.

h: אַמָּתַ֨יִם וָחֵ֜צִי אָרְכּ֗וֹ וְאַמָּ֤ה וָחֵ֙צִי֙ רָחְבּ֔וֹ
t: וַעֲבַד בְּצַלְאֵל יָת אֲרוֹנָא דְּאָעֵי שִׁטִּין
תַּרְתֵּין אַמִּין וּפַלְגָּא אֻרְכֵּיהּ וְאַמְּתָא וּפַלְגָא פְתָיֵהּ
e: Betzalel made the ark of acacia wood,
two and one-half amohs long, one and one-half amohs wide,
and one and one-half amohs high.

t: וַעֲבַד לֵיהּ דֵּיר דִּדְהַב סְחוֹר סְחוֹר:
e: He covered it with pure gold from inside and out.
He made for it a golden crown-like rim around (its top).
He cast four gold rings
on its (the ark’s) four corners,
two rings on one side
and two rings
on the other side.
He made two poles of acacia wood,
and overlaid them with gold.
He placed the poles in the rings
on the sides of the ark,
so that the ark can be carried with them.
He made a cover (for the ark) of pure gold,
two and one-half amohs long,
and one and one-half amohs wide.
He made two golden Cherubim.
He hammered them
out of the two ends of the (ark) cover.

t: מִן כַּפֻּרְתָּא עֲבַד יָת כְּרוּבַיָּא מִתְּרֵין סִטְרוֹהִי:
e: One Cherub out of one end [side],
and one Cherub out of the other end [side].
From the (same piece of gold as the) cover itself, he made the Cherubim on its two ends [sides].
eo: One Cherub out of one side,
and one Cherub out of the other side.
From the (same piece of gold as the) cover itself, he made the Cherubim on its two sides.

plus: the same piece of gold as

h: וַיִּהְי֣וּ הַכְּרֻבִים֩ פֹּרְשֵׂ֨י כְנָפַ֜יִם לְמַ֗עְלָה סֹֽכְכִ֤ים בְּכַנְפֵיהֶם֙ עַל־הַכַּפֹּ֔רֶת
t: וַהֲווֹ כְרוּבַיָּא פְּרִיסָן גַּדְפֵיהוֹן לְעֵלָּא נָטְלִין בְּגַדְפֵיהוֹן עַל כַּפֻּרְתָּא
e: The Cherubim had their wings spread upward, sheltering the cover with their wings,
and they faced one another,
the Cherubim’s faces were (inclined) toward the cover.
He made a table out of acacia wood,
two amohs long, one amoh wide,
and one and one-half amohs high.

t: וַעֲבַד לֵיהּ דֵּיר דִּדְהַב סְחוֹר סְחוֹר:
e: He overlaid it with pure gold,
and he made a crown-like rim around it.

t: וַעֲבַד לֵיהּ גְּדַנְפָא רוּמֵיהּ פּוּשְׁכָא סְחוֹר סְחוֹר
וַעֲבַד דֵּיר דִּדְהַב לִגְדַנְפֵיהּ סְחוֹר סְחוֹר:
e: He made a ledge of a tefach [high] around (the table),
and he made a gold crown-like rim around the ledge.
eo: He made a ledge of a tefach high around (the table),
and he made a gold crown-like rim around the ledge.

e: He cast for it (the table) four gold rings,
and placed the rings
on the four corners
that are on its four legs.
The rings were against the ledge
as houses (receptacles) for the poles
with which to carry the table.
He made the poles out of acacia wood,
and overlaid them with gold
with which to carry the table.

h: וַיַּ֜עַשׂ אֶֽת־הַכֵּלִ֣ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־הַשֻּׁלְחָ֗ן אֶת־קְעָרֹתָ֤יו וְאֶת־כַּפֹּתָיו֙ וְאֵת֙ מְנַקִּיֹּתָ֔יו
t: וַעֲבַד יָת מָנַיָּא דִּי עַל פָּתוֹרָא יָת מָגִיסוֹהִי וְיָת בָּזִיכוֹהִי וְיָת מְכִילָתֵיהּ
e: He made the vessels that were on the table, its dishes (bread shapes), its spoons (incense bowls), its supports,
and its half-hollow tubes by which they (the breads) are covered,
out of pure gold.

t: נְגִיד עֲבַד יָת מְנַרְתָּא שִׁידַהּ וּקְנַהּ
e: He made the menorah (out) of pure gold.
The menorah was made by hammering (its form out of a solid piece of gold). Its base, its shaft,
its cups, its knobs, and its flowers were of it (the same piece of gold).
Six branches
extended from its sides,
three branches of the menorah from one of its sides,
and three branches of the menorah
from the second side.

h: שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה גְ֠בִעִים מְֽשֻׁקָּדִ֞ים בַּקָּנֶ֣ה הָאֶחָד֮ כַּפְתֹּ֣ר וָפֶרַח֒
וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה גְבִעִ֗ים מְשֻׁקָּדִ֛ים בְּקָנֶ֥ה אֶחָ֖ד כַּפְתֹּ֣ר וָפָ֑רַח
t: תְּלָתָא כַלִּידִין מְצַיְּרִין בְּקַנְיָא חַד חֵזוּר וְשׁוֹשַׁן
וּתְלָתָא כַלִּידִין מְצַיְּרִין בְּקַנְיָא חַד חֵזוּר וְשׁוֹשָׁן
e: Three cups were engraved in almond-shaped patterns, on one branch with a knob and a flower,
and three cups were engraved in almond-shaped patterns, on one branch with a knob and a flower.
So was (the form) of each of the six branches
that extended from (the shaft) of the menorah.
The (shaft of the) menorah had four cups,
engraved in almond shaped patterns, with their knobs and their flowers.

h: וְכַפְתֹּ֡ר תַּחַת֩ שְׁנֵ֨י הַקָּנִ֜ים מִמֶּ֗נָּה וְכַפְתֹּר֙ תַּ֣חַת שְׁנֵ֤י הַקָּנִים֙ מִמֶּ֔נָּה
t: וְחֵזוּר תְּחוֹת תְּרֵין קְנִין מִנַּהּ וְחֵזוּר תְּחוֹת תְּרֵין קְנִין מִנַּהּ
e: There was a knob under the two branches extending from it, and a (second) knob under the (second) two branches extending from it,
and a (third) knob under the (third) two branches extending from it.
(This held true) for the six branches
that extended from it (the menorah’s shaft).
Their knobs and their branches were made out of (the menorah) itself.
It was all made of a single hammered work of pure gold.
He made seven lamps (for the menorah),
and its tongs and its (ash) scoops, of pure gold.
He made it out of a kikar of pure gold,
together with all its vessels.

h: אַמָּ֣ה אָרְכּוֹ֩ וְאַמָּ֨ה רָחְבּ֜וֹ רָב֗וּעַ וְאַמָּתַ֙יִם֙ קֹֽמָת֔וֹ
t: וַעֲבַד יָת מַדְבְּחָא דִקְטֹרֶת בּוּסְמַיָּא דְאָעֵי שִׁטִּין
אַמְּתָא אֻרְכֵּיהּ וְאַמְּתָא פְתָיֵהּ מְרַבַּע וְתַרְתֵּין אַמִּין רוּמֵיהּ
e: He made the [spice] incense altar out of acacia wood,
one amoh long and one amoh wide, it was square, and two amohs high.
Its horn-like elevations were of one piece with it.
eo: He made the spice incense altar out of acacia wood,
one amoh long and one amoh wide, it was square, and two amohs high.
Its horn-like elevations were of one piece with it.

h: וַיְצַ֨ף אֹת֜וֹ זָהָ֣ב טָה֗וֹר אֶת־גַּגּ֧וֹ וְאֶת־קִירֹתָ֛יו סָבִ֖יב וְאֶת־קַרְנֹתָ֑יו
t: וַחֲפָא יָתֵיהּ דְּהַב דְּכֵי יָת אִגָּרֵיהּ וְיָת כָּתְלוֹהִי סְחוֹר סְחוֹר וְיָת קַרְנוֹהִי
וַעֲבַד לֵיהּ דֵּיר דִּדְהַב סְחוֹר סְחוֹר:
e: He overlaid it with pure gold, on its top, its walls all around, and its horn-like elevations.
He made a gold crown-like rim all around it.

h: וּשְׁתֵּי֩ טַבְּעֹ֨ת זָהָ֜ב עָֽשָׂה־ל֣וֹ מִתַּ֣חַת לְזֵר֗וֹ עַ֚ל שְׁתֵּ֣י צַלְעֹתָ֔יו
t: וְתַרְתֵּין עִזְקַן דִּדְהַב עֲבַד לֵיהּ מִלְּרַע לְדֵירֵיהּ עַל תַּרְתֵּין זִוְיָתֵיהּ
e: He made two gold rings for it under its crown-like rim on two of its corners,
on its two opposite sides,
to house the poles
with which to carry it.
He made the poles out of acacia wood
and overlaid them with gold.
He made the sacred anointing oil
and the pure perfumed incense,
according to the work of the perfumer.

h: חָמֵשׁ֩ אַמּ֨וֹת אָרְכּ֜וֹ וְחָֽמֵשׁ־אַמּ֤וֹת רָחְבּוֹ֙ רָב֔וּעַ
t: וַעֲבַד יָת מַדְבְּחָא דַעֲלָתָא דְּאָעֵי שִׁטִּין
חֲמֵשׁ אַמִּין אֻרְכֵּיהּ וַחֲמֵשׁ אַמִּין פְּתָיֵהּ מְרַבַּע
e: He made the burnt-offering altar out of acacia wood.
It was five amohs long and five amohs wide, it was square,
and three amohs high.
He made its raised projections on its four corners.
Its raised projections were one piece with it,
and he overlaid it with copper.

h: וַיַּ֜עַשׂ אֶֽת־כָּל־כְּלֵ֣י הַמִּזְבֵּ֗חַ אֶת־הַסִּירֹ֤ת וְאֶת־הַיָּעִים֙ וְאֶת־הַמִּזְרָקֹ֔ת
t: וַעֲבַד יָת כָּל מָנֵי מַדְבְּחָא יָת פְּסַכְתֵּרָוָתָא וְיָת מַגְרוֹפְיָתָא וְיָת מִזְרְקָתָא
e: He made all the vessels of the altar, its pots, its scoops, its basins,
its flesh-hooks, and its fire pans.
He made all of its vessels out of copper.
He made for the altar a grate
of copper netting,
under its rim extending downward, (so that the grate reached) to the middle of the altar.

h: וַיִּצֹ֞ק אַרְבַּ֧ע טַבָּעֹ֛ת בְּאַרְבַּ֥ע הַקְּצָוֺ֖ת לְמִכְבַּ֣ר הַנְּחֹ֑שֶׁת
t: וְאַתִּיךְ אַרְבַּע עִזְקָתָא בְּאַרְבַּע סִטְרָתָא לִסְרָדָא דִנְחָשָׁא
e: He cast four rings on the four corners [sides]of the copper grating
to house the poles.
eo: He cast four rings on the four sides of the copper grating
to house the poles.

e: He made the poles of acacia wood,
and overlaid them with copper.

h: וַיָּבֵ֨א אֶת־הַבַּדִּ֜ים בַּטַּבָּעֹ֗ת עַ֚ל צַלְעֹ֣ת הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ
t: וְאָעֵיל יָת אֲרִיחַיָּא בְּעִזְקָתָא עַל סִטְרֵי מַדְבְּחָא
e: He placed the poles into the rings that were on the (two) sides of the altar
to carry it with them.
He made it a hollow structure constructed from boards.
He made the basin out of copper
and its base out of copper,
from the mirrors of the women who had
gathered [come to pray] at
the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.
eo: He made the basin out of copper
and its base out of copper,
from the mirrors of the women who had
come to pray at
the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

h: לִפְאַ֣ת נֶ֣גֶב תֵּימָ֗נָה קַלְעֵ֤י הֶֽחָצֵר֙ שֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֔ר
t: לְרוּחַ עֵבַר דָּרוֹמָא סְרָדֵי דַרְתָּא דְבוּץ שְׁזִיר
e: He made the enclosure (for the mishkon).
On the south side the curtains for the enclosure were made of fine, twined linen,
one hundred amohs long.
It had twenty pillars
and twenty copper sockets.
The hooks and bands of the pillars were of silver.
On the north side, (its length was) one hundred amohs.
It had twenty pillars
and twenty copper sockets.
The hooks and bands of the pillars were of silver.
On the west side, the curtains were of fifty amohs.
It had ten pillars
and ten sockets.
The hooks and bands of the pillars were of silver.
(The width of the enclosure) on the east side was fifty amohs.
Curtains fifteen amohs long were on one flank (of the entrance).
They had three pillars
and three sockets.

h: וְלַכָּתֵ֣ף הַשֵּׁנִ֗ית מִזֶּ֤ה וּמִזֶּה֙ לְשַׁ֣עַר הֶֽחָצֵ֔ר
t: וּלְעִבְרָא תִנְיֵתָא מִכָּא וּמִכָּא לִתְרַע דַּרְתָּא
e: The other flank, on either side of the gate to the enclosure
(there also were) curtains fifteen amohs long.
They (too) had three pillars
and three sockets.

t: כָּל סְרָדֵי דְדַרְתָּא סְחוֹר סְחוֹר דְּבוּץ שְׁזִיר:
e: All curtains around the enclosure were made of twined, fine linen.

h: וְהֵם֙ מְחֻשָּׁקִ֣ים כֶּ֔סֶף כֹּ֖ל עַמֻּדֵ֥י הֶחָצֵֽר׃
t: וְאִנּוּן מְכַבְּשִׁין דִּכְסַף כָּל עַמּוּדֵי דַרְתָּא:
e: The sockets for the pillars were of copper,
the hooks and bands of the pillars were of silver,
and the covering of their tops was of silver.
All pillars of the enclosure had silver bands.

h: תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֑ר
e: The screen at the entrance of the enclosure was the work of an embroiderer.
It was made of greenish blue wool, dark red wool, crimson [colored] wool, and twined, fine linen.
It was twenty amohs long
and the height in the width was five amohs,
corresponding to the curtains of the enclosure.

It was twenty amohs long
and the height in the width was five amohs,
corresponding to the curtains of the enclosure.

map: It was made of greenish blue wool

e: (The screen) had four pillars
and four copper sockets,
silver hooks,
and their tops and bands were overlaid with silver.

t: וְכָל סִכַּיָּא לְמַשְׁכְּנָא וּלְדַרְתָּא סְחוֹר סְחוֹר דִּנְחָשָׁא:
e: All the stakes of the mishkon and the surrounding enclosure were made of copper.

R: ויקהל משה. לְמָחֳרַת יוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים כְּשֶׁיָּרַד מִן הָהָר, וְהוּא לְשׁוֹן הִפְעִיל, שֶׁאֵינוֹ אוֹסֵף אֲנָשִׁים בְּיָּדַיִם, אֶלָּא הֵן נֶאֱסָפִין עַל פִּי דִּבּוּרוֹ, וְתַרְגּוּמוֹ וְאַכְנֵישׁ:
ששת ימים. הִקְדִּים לָהֶם אַזְהָרַת שַׁבָּת לְצִוּוּי מְלֶאכֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן, לוֹמַר שֶׁאֵינוֹ דוֹחֶה אֶת הַשַּׁבָּת (מכילתא):
לא תבערו אש. יֵשׁ מֵרַבּוֹתֵינוּ אוֹמְרִים הַבְעָרָה לְלָאו יָצָאת, וְיֵשׁ אוֹמְרִים לְחַלֵּק יָצָאת (שבת ע'):
זה הדבר אשר צוה ה'. לִי לאמר לָכֶם:
נדיב לבו. עַל שֵׁם שֶׁלִּבּוֹ נוֹדְבוֹ, קָרוּי נְדִיב לֵב. כְּבָר פֵּרַשְׁתִּי נִדְבַת הַמִּשְׁכָּן וּמְלַאכְתּוֹ בִּמְקוֹם צַוָּאתָן:
את המשכן. יְרִיעוֹת הַתַּחְתּוֹנוֹת הַנִּרְאוֹת בְּתוֹכוֹ קְרוּיִים מִשְׁכָּן:
את אהלו. הִיא אֹהֶל יְרִיעוֹת עִזִּים, הֶעָשׂוּי לְגַג:
ואת מכסהו. מִכְסֵה עוֹרוֹת אֵילִים וְהַתְּחָשִׁים:
ואת פרכת המסך. פָּרֹכֶת הַמְּחִיצָה; כָּל דָּבָר הַמֵּגֵן, בֵּין מִלְמַעְלָה בֵּין מִכְּנֶגֶד, קָרוּי מָסָךְ וּסְכָךְ, וְכֵן סַכְתָּ בַעֲדוֹ (איוב א'), הִנְנִי סָךְ אֶת דַּרְכֵּךְ (הושע ב'):
לחם הפנים. כְּבָר פֵּרַשְׁתִּי, עַל שֵׁם שֶׁהָיוּ לוֹ פָּנִים לְכָאן וּלְכָאן, שֶׁהוּא עָשׂוּי כְּמִין תֵּבָה פְרוּצָה:
ואת כליה. מֶלְקָחַיִם וּמַחְתּוֹת:
נרתיה. לוצי"יש בְּלַעַז, בָּזִיכִים שֶׁהַשֶּׁמֶן וְהַפְּתִילוֹת נְתוּנִין בָּהֶן:
ואת שמן המאור. אַף הוּא צָרִיךְ חַכְמֵי לֵב, שֶׁהוּא מְשֻׁנֶּה מִשְּׁאָר שְׁמָנִים, כְּמוֹ שֶׁמְּפֹרָשׁ בִּמְנָחוֹת (דף פ"ו), מְגַרְגְּרוֹ בְרֹאשׁ הַזַּיִת, וְהוּא כָּתִית וְזַךְ:
מסך הפתח. וִילוֹן שֶׁלִּפְנֵי הַמִּזְרָח, שֶׁלֹּא הָיוּ שָׁם קְרָשִׁים וְלֹא יְרִיעוֹת:
את עמדיו ואת אדניה. הֲרֵי חָצֵר קָרוּי כָּאן לְשׁוֹן זָכָר וּלְשׁוֹן נְקֵבָה, וְכֵן דְּבָרִים הַרְבֵּה:

ואת מסך שער החצר. וִילוֹן פָּרוּשׂ לְצַד הַמִּזְרָח עֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה אֶמְצָעִיּוֹת שֶׁל רֹחַב הֶחָצֵר – שֶׁהָיָה חֲמִשִּׁים רֹחַב – וּסְתוּמִין הֵימֶנּוּ לְצַד צָפוֹן ט"ו אַמָּה, וְכֵן לַדָּרוֹם, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר, וַחֲמֵשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה אַמָּה קְלָעִים לַכָּתֵף:
יתדת. לִתְקֹעַ וְלִקְשׁוֹר בָּהֶם סוֹפֵי הַיְרִיעוֹת בָּאָרֶץ, שֶׁלֹּא יָנוּעוּ בָּרוּחַ:
מיתריהם. חֲבָלִים לִקְשֹׁר:
בגדי השרד. לְכַסּוֹת הָאָרוֹן וְהַשֻּׁלְחָן, הַמְּנוֹרָה וְהַמִּזְבְּחוֹת בִּשְׁעַת סִלּוּק מַסָּעוֹת:
(על הנשים. עִם הַנָּשִׁים וּסְמוּכִין אֲלֵיהֶן):
חח. הוּא תַּכְשִׁיט שֶׁל זָהָב עָגֹל, נָתוּן עַל הַזְּרוֹעַ, וְהוּא הַצָּמִיד:
וכומז. כְּלִי זָהָב הוּא נָתוּן כְּנֶגֶד אוֹתוֹ מָקוֹם לָאִשָּׁה, וְרַבּוֹתֵינוּ פֵּרְשׁוּ שֵׁם כּוּמָז, כָּאן מְקוֹם זִמָּה (שבת ס"ד):
וכל איש אשר נמצא אתו. תְּכֵלֶת אוֹ אַרְגָּמָן אוֹ תוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי אוֹ עוֹרוֹת אֵילִים אוֹ תְּחָשִׁים כֻּלָּם הֵבִיאוּ:
טוו את העזים. הִיא הָיְתָה אָמָּנוּת יְתֵרָה, שֶׁמֵּעַל גַּבֵּי הָעִזִּים טוֹוִין אוֹתָם (שבת ע"ד):

והנשאם הביאו. אָמַר רַ' נָתָן: מָה רָאוּ נְשִׂיאִים לְהִתְנַדֵּב בַּחֲנֻכַּת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ בַּתְּחִלָּה וּבִמְלֶאכֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן לֹא הִתְנַדְּבוּ בַּתְּחִלָּה? אֶלָּא כָּךְ אָמְרוּ נְשִׂיאִים, יִתְנַדְּבוּ צִבּוּר מַה שֶּׁמִּתְנַדְּבִין, וּמַה שֶּׁמְּחַסְּרִים, אָנוּ מַשְׁלִימִין אוֹתוֹ, כֵּיוָן שֶׁהִשְׁלִימוּ צִבּוּר אֶת הַכֹּל – שֶׁנֶּ' וְהַמְּלָאכָה הָיְתָה דַיָּם – אָמְרוּ נְשִׂיאִים מֶה עָלֵינוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת? הביאו את אבני השהם וְגוֹ', לְכָךְ הִתְנַדְּבוּ בַּחֲנֻכַּת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ תְּחִלָּה, וּלְפִי שֶׁנִּתְעַצְּלוּ מִתְּחִלָּה נֶחְסְרָה אוֹת מִשְּׁמָם, וְהַנְּשִׂאִם כְּתִיב (ספרי במדבר מ"ה):
חור. בְּנָהּ שֶׁל מִרְיָם הָיָה:

ואהליאב. מִשֵּׁבֶט דָּן מִן הַיְרוּדִין שֶׁבַּשְּׁבָטִים – מִבְּנֵי הַשְּׁפָחוֹת – וְהִשְׁוָהוּ הַמָּקוֹם לִבְצַלְאֵל לִמְלֶאכֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְהוּא מִגְּדוֹלֵי הַשְּׁבָטִים, לְקַיֵּם מַה שֶּׁנֶּ' וְלֹא נִכַּר שׁוֹעַ לִפְנֵי דָל (איוב ל"ד):
מדי העבדה. יוֹתֵר מִכְּדֵי צֹרֶךְ הָעֲבוֹדָה:
ויכלא. לְשׁוֹן מְנִיעָה:
והמלאכה היתה דים לכל המלאכה. וּמְלֶאכֶת הַהֲבָאָה הָיְתָה דַיָּם שֶׁל עוֹשֵׂי הַמִּשְׁכָּן, לְכָל הַמְּלָאכָה שֶׁל מִשְׁכָּן, לַעֲשׂוֹת אוֹתָהּ וּלְהוֹתֵר:
והותר. כְּמוֹ וְהַכְבֵּד אֶת לִבּוֹ (שמות ח'), וְהַכּוֹת אֶת מוֹאָב (מלכים ב ג'):
ויעש בצלאל. לְפִי שֶׁנָּתַן נַפְשׁוֹ עַל הַמְּלָאכָה יוֹתֵר מִשְּׁאָר חֲכָמִים, נִקְרֵאת עַל שְׁמוֹ (שמות רבה):
נבוב לחת. נָבוּב הוּא חָלוּל, וְכֵן וְעָבְיוֹ אַרְבַּע אֶצְבָּעוֹת נָבוּב (ירמיהו נ"ב):
נבוב לחת. הַלּוּחוֹת שֶׁל עֲצֵי שִׁטִּים לְכָל רוּחַ, וְהֶחָלָל בָּאֶמְצַע:

במראת הצבאת. בְּנוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל הָיוּ בְיָדָן מַרְאוֹת שֶׁרוֹאוֹת בָּהֶן כְּשֶׁהֵן מִתְקַשְּׁטוֹת, וְאַף אוֹתָן לֹא עִכְּבוּ מִלְּהָבִיא לְנִדְבַת הַמִּשְׁכָּן, וְהָיָה מוֹאֵס מֹשֶׁה בָּהֶן מִפְּנֵי שֶׁעֲשׂוּיִם לְיֵצֶר הָרָע, אָמַר לוֹ הַקָּבָּ"ה קַבֵּל, כִּי אֵלּוּ חֲבִיבִין עָלַי מִן הַכֹּל, שֶׁעַל יְדֵיהֶם הֶעֱמִידוּ הַנָּשִׁים צְבָאוֹת רַבּוֹת בְּמִצְרַיִם; כְּשֶׁהָיוּ בַעְלֵיהֶם יְגֵעִים בַּעֲבוֹדַת פֶּרֶךְ, הָיוּ הוֹלְכוֹת וּמוֹלִיכוֹת לָהֶם מַאֲכָל וּמִשְׁתֶּה, וּמַאֲכִילוֹת אוֹתָם וְנוֹטְלוֹת הַמַּרְאוֹת, וְכָל אַחַת רוֹאָה עַצְמָהּ עִם בַּעְלָהּ בַּמַּרְאָה, וּמְשַׁדַּלְתּוֹ בִדְבָרִים, לוֹמַר אֲנִי נָאָה מִמְּךָ, וּמִתּוֹךְ כָּךְ מְבִיאוֹת לְבַעְלֵיהֶן לִידֵי תַאֲוָה וְנִזְקָקוֹת לָהֶם וּמִתְעַבְּרוֹת וְיוֹלְדוֹת שָׁם, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר תַּחַת הַתַּפּוּחַ עוֹרַרְתִּיךָ (שיר השירים ח'), וְזֶה שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר בְּמַרְאֹת הַצּוֹבְאוֹת. וְנַעֲשָׂה הַכִּיּוֹר מֵהֶם, שֶׁהוּא לָשׂוּם שָׁלוֹם בֵּין אִישׁ לְאִשְׁתּוֹ – לְהַשְׁקוֹת מִמַּיִם שֶׁבְּתוֹכוֹ לְמִי שֶׁקִּנֵּא לָהּ בַּעְלָהּ וְנִסְתְּרָה; וְתֵדַע לְךָ שֶׁהֵן מַרְאוֹת מַמָּשׁ, שֶׁהֲרֵי נֶאֱמַר וּנְחֹשֶׁת הַתְּנוּפָה שִׁבְעִים כִּכָּר וְגוֹ', וַיַּעַשׂ בָּהּ וְגוֹמֵר, וְכִיּוֹר וְכַנּוֹ לֹא הֻזְכְּרוּ שָׁם, לָמַדְתָּ שֶׁלֹּא הָיָה נְחֹשֶׁת שֶׁל כִּיּוֹר מִנְּחֹשֶׁת הַתְּנוּפָה, כָּךְ דָּרַשׁ רַבִּי תַּנְחוּמָא, וְכֵן תִּרְגֵּם אֻנְקְלוֹס בְּמֶחְזְיָת נְשַׁיָא וְהוּא תַרְגּוּם שֶׁל מַרְאוֹת, מירוריי"ש בְּלַעַז. וְכֵן מָצִינוּ וְהַגִּלְיוֹנִים (ישעיה ג') – מְתַרְגְּמִינָן מֶחְזְיָתָא:
